name: Rogue
summary: A scoundrel who uses stealth and trickery to overcome obstacles. Rogues are the party's experts: the best at skills, deadly with one precise strike each turn, and very hard to pin down.

hitPoints.Hit Points at Higher Levels: 1d8 (or 5) + your Constitution modifier per rogue level after 1st

proficiencies.Weapons: Simple weapons, hand crossbows, longswords, rapiers, shortswords
proficiencies.Skills: Choose four from Acrobatics, Athletics, Deception, Insight, Intimidation, Investigation, Perception, Performance, Persuasion, Sleight of Hand and Stealth

classFeatures.name: Expertise
keyFacts: Two skills get double proficiency at 1st level.
classFeatures.summary: Choose two of your skill proficiencies, or one of your skill proficiencies and your proficiency with thieves' tools. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either. At 6th level, choose two more.
classFeatures.short: Double your proficiency bonus on two skills (two more at 6).

choices.label: Expertise (1st level)
choices.note: Thieves' tools can be picked instead of a skill; note it on the sheet.

classFeatures.name: Sneak Attack
keyFacts: Once per turn, with advantage or an ally next to the target.
classFeatures.summary: Once per turn, you can deal extra damage to one creature you hit with an attack if you have advantage on the roll. The attack must use a finesse or a ranged weapon. You don't need advantage if another enemy of the target is within 5 feet of it, that enemy isn't incapacitated, and you don't have disadvantage on the roll.
classFeatures.short: Once per turn, deal extra damage with finesse or ranged attacks.

grants.text: Sneak Attack: once per turn, extra damage on a finesse or ranged weapon hit with advantage, or when an ally is within 5 ft. of the target.

classFeatures.name: Thieves' Cant
keyFacts: Hide messages in normal speech; read thieves' signs.
classFeatures.summary: You know thieves' cant, a secret mix of dialect, jargon and code that lets you hide messages in seemingly normal conversation, plus a set of secret signs for marking places.

classFeatures.name: Cunning Action
keyFacts: Dash, Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.
classFeatures.summary: You can take a bonus action on each of your turns to take the Dash, Disengage or Hide action.
classFeatures.short: Bonus action: Dash, Disengage or Hide.

grants.text: Cunning Action: bonus action to Dash, Disengage or Hide.

classFeatures.name: Roguish Archetype
classFeatures.summary: Choose an archetype that you emulate in the exercise of your rogue abilities. It grants features at 3rd, 9th, 13th and 17th level.

classFeatures.name: Ability Score Improvement
keyFacts: +2 to one ability or +1 to two, or a feat.
classFeatures.summary: When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 10th, 12th, 16th, 19th level, you can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1. You can't raise a score above 20 this way. If your DM allows feats, you can take a feat instead.
classFeatures.short: Raise one ability by 2, two by 1, or take a feat.

classFeatures.name: Uncanny Dodge
keyFacts: Reaction: take half damage from one hit.
classFeatures.summary: When an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to halve the attack's damage against you.
classFeatures.short: Reaction: halve damage from an attack you see.

classFeatures.name: Evasion
keyFacts: DEX save for half: success = 0, failure = half.
classFeatures.summary: When you are subjected to an effect that allows a Dexterity save for half damage, you take no damage on a success and only half on a failure.
classFeatures.short: No damage on successful DEX saves, half on failures.

classFeatures.name: Reliable Talent
keyFacts: Treat d20 rolls of 9 or lower as 10 on proficient checks.
classFeatures.summary: Whenever you make an ability check that lets you add your proficiency bonus, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

classFeatures.name: Blindsense
keyFacts: Know where hidden and invisible creatures within 10 ft. are.
classFeatures.summary: If you are able to hear, you are aware of the location of any hidden or invisible creature within 10 feet of you.
classFeatures.short: Sense hidden or invisible creatures within 10 ft.

grants.note: Blindsense: you hear hidden and invisible creatures

classFeatures.name: Slippery Mind
classFeatures.summary: You have acquired greater mental strength. You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws.

classFeatures.name: Elusive
keyFacts: No advantage on attacks against you unless you are incapacitated.
classFeatures.summary: No attack roll has advantage against you while you aren't incapacitated.
classFeatures.short: Attacks never have advantage against you.

classFeatures.name: Stroke of Luck
keyFacts: Once per short or long rest.
classFeatures.summary: If your attack misses a target in range, you can turn the miss into a hit. Or, if you fail an ability check, you can treat the d20 roll as a 20. Once per short or long rest.
classFeatures.short: Turn a miss into a hit, or a failed check into a 20.

journeyStages.label: Class
journeyStages.summary: Review the rogue at a glance.

journeyStages.label: Class Features
journeyStages.summary: What your class gives you, level by level.

options.label: Leather Armor, Two Daggers and Thieves' Tools

highlights.title: Combat Role
highlights.body: One big Sneak Attack per turn from range or with a finesse weapon, then slip away with Cunning Action.

highlights.title: Core Resources
highlights.body: No limited resources: Sneak Attack works every turn. Expertise makes you the best at your chosen skills.

highlights.title: Level Rhythm
highlights.body: Cunning Action at 2, archetype at 3, Uncanny Dodge at 5, more Expertise at 6, Evasion at 7, Reliable Talent at 11.
